name: Serialize snapshot refreshes with a trailing invalidation pass
description: When a stream event invalidates data while its unary snapshot read is already in flight, sharing only the current promise can publish a pre-event snapshot and lose the invalidation. Record a pending bit/key set, let the active read settle, then immediately run one coalesced trailing read. Fence timer, flush, response, and trailing work by lifecycle/key generation; authoritative replacement or key change cancels the pending pass.
example: useCoalescedSessionRefreshes serializes callback passes and useCharacterData loops once more when refetch marks its active read invalidated.
anti_pattern: Returning the current in-flight promise without recording that a newer event arrived, or launching an overlapping refresh that permits reversed responses.

name: Separate last-good display from execution freshness
description: For server-authored command declarations, retaining the last successful values improves continuity, but those values must not remain dispatch authority after an event, refetch, or error. Expose a separate fresh flag and synchronous invalidate operation. Revoke freshness before scheduling reconciliation; restore it only on a successful response for the newest current key/generation.
example: useSessionTurn/useSessionAfford retain old display while fresh=false; SessionEncounterView synchronously invalidates both on every delivered sequence, and CombatExperience disables Attack, Move preview/dispatch, and End Turn until both are fresh and coherent.
anti_pattern: Treating last-good values as executable after background refresh begins/fails, or clearing useful display just to fail closed.

name: Fail closed and reconcile ambiguous mutation outcomes without replay
description: A successful command response and a non-precondition transport failure can both mean server state changed before an event arrives. Revoke old execution authority synchronously, preserve honest presentation facts, and queue serialized authoritative reads. Never automatically replay a mutation whose commit status is unknown.
example: Move acceptance invalidates Turn/Afford before animation; non-FAILED_PRECONDITION Attack and EndTurn failures clear selection, retain their error, invalidate authority, and schedule the same authoritative reconciliation as success.
anti_pattern: Leaving old declarations executable until a stream event arrives, or retrying an Attack/EndTurn after an unavailable/unknown response.

name: Gate R3F rendered-pose witnesses by renderer frame advancement
description: React Three Fiber useFrame callbacks run before the renderer draws the mutations applied in that callback. For completion or settlement truth, retain the target pose with gl.info.render.frame at application and emit its witness only when a later frame observes a greater renderer frame counter. Fence the pending witness to the callback/phase identity so rerenders cannot emit stale pose facts.
example: RuntimeDiceMesh exposes onFrameDrawn after renderer frame advancement; RollGroupRuntimeMember uses that seam for original, reroll, and final all-member witnesses.
anti_pattern: Treating a pose mutation or a useFrame callback as proof that the user-visible frame was rendered.
